operations.summary: Release 1 email change: SELECT account then UPDATE only email
Release 2 plan change: single UPDATE of plan and plan_changed_by

conflicts.risk_explanation: Concurrent email-only (v1) and plan (v2) UPDATEs hit the same row on disjoint columns. If either did a stale read-modify-write or full-row ORM save it would overwrite email with a stale value and lose the email change.

v1 SELECTs plan but should only write email. If v1 rewrote plan from its stale SELECT it would revert a concurrent v2 plan change. Two concurrent v2 plan changes also race on this column last-writer-wins.

New nullable column added by migration and unknown to v1. If v1 performs a full-row write or resets unknown columns to NULL/default from its stale SELECT, a concurrent v2 attribution value is wiped. Classic added-column wipe during rolling deployment.

tests.name: email_vs_plan_same_row
tests.rationale: Rolling deployment: v1 writes only email, v2 writes plan+attribution on same account. Correct disjoint-column UPDATEs both persist regardless of commit order. A full-row overwrite or stale ORM save would lose one side.

invariants.description: email-only update must persist despite concurrent plan update
plan update must persist despite concurrent email update
attribution set by v2 must not be wiped by v1 email update

tests.name: concurrent_emails_preserve_attribution
tests.rationale: Two old-release email changes race on email last-writer-wins but must leave plan and new attribution column untouched. Detects v1 clearing plan_changed_by to NULL/default.

invariants.description: one of the two concurrent emails must win
concurrent email writes must not modify plan
concurrent email writes must not clear pre-existing attribution

tests.name: concurrent_plans_preserve_email
tests.rationale: Two new-release plan changes race on plan/attribution last-writer-wins but must leave email untouched. Detects v2 full-row write wiping the old email column.

invariants.description: concurrent plan writes must not modify email
one of the two concurrent plans must win
attribution must be one of the two writers, never wiped to NULL
